text: DP World announced the immediate resignation of Sultan Ahmed bin Sulayem as chairman and CEO and appointed Essa Kazim as chairman and Yuvraj Narayan as group CEO. The change followed DOJ document releases detailing Sulayem's past contact with Jeffrey Epstein and subsequent pauses on new investments by partners including La Caisse and British International Investment.

meta.note: Corporate leadership shift followed external investor suspension actions.

text: Treasury Secretary Scott Bessent said Senate Banking Committee hearings for nominee Kevin Warsh should proceed despite an ongoing DOJ investigation into current Fed Chair Jerome Powell. Sen. Thom Tillis vowed to block Warsh's confirmation until the probe ends, while Trump supports continuation of the investigation, creating an intra-party impasse over Fed leadership and independence.

meta.note: Nomination process and criminal inquiry operate on parallel tracks.

text: January CPI rose 2.4% y/y, down 0.3 percentage point from December, with core CPI at 2.5%, the lowest since April 2021. Monthly gains were 0.2% headline and 0.3% core. Shelter increased 0.2% m/m (3% y/y), energy fell 1.5%, and used vehicle prices declined 1.8%. Inflation remained above the Fed's 2% goal as markets increased odds of a June rate cut.

meta.note: Cooling trend coexists with persistent above-target inflation.
